_comment_roots: Folders to scan. Use "auto" to let the scanner pick the drives itself, or list absolute paths, e.g. ["D:\\projects"].
_comment_acpDelegatePath: Optional. Absolute path to the ACP delegate script used for AI repairs. Leave empty to resolve it from ACP_DELEGATE_PATH, a sibling checkout, or the acp command on PATH.
_comment_supervisorAutoFix: When true, the supervisor may send an AI agent to rewrite a project that keeps crashing, with no human in the loop. Off by default: that path is unattended and writes to your project folders.
_comment_delegateTimeoutMinutes: How long an AI repair may run before it is killed. A dependency install that downloads browsers needs more than the old fixed 5 minutes. Range 1-60.
